card.name: Start of a split word after a sentence break
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that starts a new sentence or heading in drug-interaction text, such as Gly in glycosides, Inter in interactions, Part in particular, or cross in cross-over.

modes.label: Drug-class heading
modes.description: The first piece of a drug class or drug name that begins a new interaction entry.

modes.label: Sentence-opening word start
modes.description: The first piece of a word such as interactions or particular that opens a new sentence.

modes.label: Study or term word start
modes.description: The first piece of a longer word inside a sentence, such as cross-over or intercurrent.
